dn14:1.1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme Kareri-kuṭikāyaṃ.
dn14:1.1.3: Atha kho sambahulānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ pacchā-bhattaṃ piṇḍapāta-paṭikkantānaṃ Kareri-maṇḍala-māḷe sannisinnānaṃ sannipatitānaṃ pubbe-nivāsa-paṭisaṃyuttā dhammī kathā udapādi:
dn14:1.2.1: Assosi kho Bhagavā dibbāya sota-dhātuyā visuddhāya atikkanta-mānusikāya tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ imaṃ kathāsallāpaṃ.
dn14:1.2.2: Atha kho Bhagavā uṭṭhāy' āsanā yena Karerimaṇḍala-māḷo ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi. Nisajja kho Bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi:
dn14:1.2.3: ‘Kāya nu 'ttha bhikkhave etarahi kathāya sannisinnā, kā ca pana vo antarā kathā vippakatā ti?'
dn14:1.2.4: Evaṃ vutte te bhikkhū Bhagavantaṃ etad avocuṃ:
dn14:1.2.5: ‘Idha bhante amhākaṃ pacchā-bhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkantānaṃ Kareri-maṇḍala-māḷe sannisinnānaṃ sannipatitānaṃ pubbe-nivāsa-paṭisaṃyuttā dhammī kathā udapādi:
dn14:1.2.7: Ayaṃ kho no bhante antarā kathā vippakatā atha Bhagavā anuppatto ti.' 3.
dn14:1.3.1: ‘Iccheyyātha no tumhe bhikkhave pubbe-nivāsapaṭisaṃyuttaṃ dhammiṃ kathaṃ sotun ti?'
dn14:1.3.3: yaṃ bhagavā pubbe-nivāsa-paṭisaṃyuttaṃ dhammiṃ kathaṃ kareyya, Bhagavato sutvā bhikkhū dhāressantīti.'
dn14:1.3.4: ‘Tena hi bhikkhave suṇātha, sādhukaṃ manasikarotha, bhāsissāmīti.'
dn14:1.3.5: ‘Evaṃ bhante' ti kho te bhikkhū Bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
dn14:1.4.1: ‘Ito so bhikkhave eka-navuto kappo yaṃ Vipassī bhagavā arahaṃ sammā-sambuddho loke udapādi.
dn14:1.4.2: Ito so bhikkhave eka-tiṃso kappo yaṃ Sikhī bhagavā arahaṃ sammā-sambuddho loke udapādi.
dn14:1.4.3: Tasmiṃ yeva kho bhikkhave eka-tiṃse kappe Vessabhū bhagavā arahaṃ sammā-sambuddho loke udapādi.
dn14:1.4.4: Imasmiṃ yeva kho bhikkhave bhadda-kappe Kakusandho bhagavā arahaṃ sammā-sambuddho loke udapādi.
dn14:1.4.5: Imasmiṃ yeva kho bhikkhave bhadda-kappe Konāgamano bhagavā arahaṃ sammā-sambuddho loke udapādi.
dn14:1.4.6: Imasmiṃ yeva kho bhikkhave bhadda-kappe Kassapo bhagavā arahaṃ sammā-sambuddho loke udapādi.
dn14:1.4.7: Imasmiṃ yeva kho bhikkhave bhadda-kappe ahaṃ etarahi arahaṃ sammāsambuddho loke uppanno. 5.
dn14:1.5.1: ‘Vipassī bhikkhave bhagavā arahaṃ sammā-sambuddho khattiyo jātiyā ahosi, khattiya-kule udapādi.
dn14:1.5.2: Sikhī bhikkhave bhagavā arahaṃ sammā-sambuddho khattiyo jātiyā ahosi, khattiya-kule udapādi.
dn14:1.5.3: Vessabhū bhikkhave bhagavā arahaṃ sammā-sambuddho khattiyo jātiyā ahosi, khattiya-kule udapādi.
dn14:1.5.4: Kakusandho bhikkhave bhagavā arahaṃ sammā-sambuddho brāhmaṇo jātiyā ahosi, brāhmaṇa-kule udapādi.
dn14:1.5.5: Konāgamano bhikkhave bhagavā arahaṃ sammā- sambuddho brāhmaṇo jātiyā ahosi, brāhmaṇa-kule udapādi.
dn14:1.5.6: Kassapo bhikkhave bhagavā arahaṃ sammā-sambuddho brāhmaṇo jātiyā ahosi, brāhmaṇa-kule udapādi.
dn14:1.5.7: Ahaṃ bhikkhave etarahi arahaṃ sammā-sambuddho khattiyo jātiyā ahosiṃ, khattiya-kule uppanno. 6.
dn14:1.6.1: ‘Vipassī bhikkhave bhagavā arahaṃ sammā-sambuddho Koṇḍañño gottena ahosi.
dn14:1.6.2: Sikhī bhikkhave bhagavā arahaṃ sammā-sambuddho Koṇḍañño gottena ahosi.
dn14:1.6.3: Vessabhū bhikkhave bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho Koṇḍañño gottena ahosi.
dn14:1.6.4: Kakusandho bhikkhave bhagavā arahaṃ sammā-sambuddho Kassapo gottena ahosi.
dn14:1.6.5: Konāgamano bhikkhave bhagavā arahaṃ sammā-sambuddho Kassapo gottena ahosi.
dn14:1.6.6: Kassapo bhikkhave bhagavā arahaṃ sammā-sambuddho Kassapo gottena ahosi.
dn14:1.6.7: Ahaṃ bhikkhave etarahi arahaṃ sammāsambuddho Gotamo gottena. 7.
dn14:1.7.1: ‘Vipassissa bhikkhave bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa asītiṃ vassa-sahassāni āyuppamāṇaṃ ahosi.
dn14:1.7.2: Sikhissa bhikkhave bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa sattati vassa-sahassāni āyuppamāṇaṃ ahosi.
dn14:1.7.3: Vessabhussa bhikkhave bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa saṭṭhi vassa-sahassāni āyuppamāṇaṃ ahosi.
dn14:1.7.4: Kakusandhassa bhikkhave bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa cattārīsaṃ vassa-sahassāni āyuppamāṇaṃ ahosi.
dn14:1.7.5: Konāgamanassa bhikkhave bhagavato arahato sammā-sambuddhassa tiṃsa vassa-sahassāni āyuppamāṇaṃ ahosi.
dn14:1.7.6: Kassapassa bhikkhave bhagavato arahato sammā-sambuddhassa vīsatiṃ vassa-sahassāni āyuppamāṇaṃ ahosi.
dn14:1.7.7: Mayhaṃ bhikkhave etarahi appakaṃ āyuppamāṇaṃ parittaṃ lahusaṃ, yo ciraṃ jīvati so vassasataṃ appaṃ vā bhiyyo. 8.
dn14:1.8.1: ‘Vipassī bhikkhave bhagavā arahaṃ sammā-sambuddho pāṭaliyā mūle abhisambuddho.
dn14:1.8.2: Sikhī bhikkhave bhagavā arahaṃ sammā-sambuddho puṇḍarīkassa mūle abhisambuddho.
dn14:1.8.3: Vessabhū bhikkhave bhagavā arahaṃ sammā-sambuddho sālassa mūle abhisambuddho.
dn14:1.8.4: Kakusandho bhikkhave bhagavā arahaṃ sammā-sambuddho sirīsassa mūle abhisambuddho.
dn14:1.8.5: Konāgamano bhikkhave bhagavā arahaṃ sammā-sambuddho udumbarassa mūle abhisambuddho.
dn14:1.8.6: Kassapo bhikkhave bhagavā arahaṃ sammā-sambuddho nigrodhassa mūle abhisambuddho
dn14:1.8.7: Ahaṃ bhikkhave etarahi arahaṃ sammā-sambuddho assatthassa mūle abhisambuddho. 9.
dn14:1.9.1: ‘Vipassissa bhikkhave bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa Khaṇḍa-Tissaṃ nāma sāvaka-yugaṃ ahosi aggaṃ bhadda-yugaṃ.
dn14:1.9.2: Sakhissa bhikkhave bhagavato arahato sammā-sambuddhassa Abhibhū-Sambhavaṃ nāma sāvaka-yugaṃ ahosi aggaṃ bhadda-yugaṃ.
dn14:1.9.3: Vessabhussa bhikkhave bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa Soṇ-Uttaraṃ nāma sāvaka-yugaṃ ahosi aggaṃ bhadda-yugaṃ.
dn14:1.9.4: Kakusandhassa bhikkhave bhagavato arahato sammā-sambuddhassa Vidhūra-Sañjīvaṃ nāma sāvaka-yugaṃ ahosi aggaṃ bhadda-yugaṃ.
dn14:1.9.5: Konāgamanassa bhikkhave bhagavato arahato sammā-sambuddhassa Bhiyyos-Uttaraṃ nāma sāvaka-yugaṃ ahosi aggaṃ bhadda-yugaṃ.
dn14:1.9.6: kassapassa bhikkhave bhagavato arahato sammā-sambuddhassa Tissa-Bhāradvājaṃ nāma sāvaka-yugaṃ ahosi aggaṃ bhadda-yugaṃ.
dn14:1.9.7: Mayhaṃ bhikkhave etarahi Sāriputta-Moggallānaṃ nāma sāvakayugaṃ ahosi aggaṃ bhadda-yugaṃ. 10.
dn14:1.10.1: ‘Vipassissa bhikkhave bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa tayo sāvakānaṃ sannipātā ahesuṃ. Eko sāvakānaṃ sannipāto ahosi aṭṭha-saṭṭhi- bhikkhu-sata sahassaṃ. Eko sāvakānaṃ sannipāto ahosi bhikkhu-sata sahassaṃ. Eko sāvakānaṃ sannipāto ahosi asīti-bhikkhusahassāni. Vipassissa bhikkhave bhagavato arahato sammā-sambuddhassa ime tayo sāvakānaṃ sannipātā ahesuṃ sabbesaṃ yeva khīṇāsavānaṃ.
dn14:1.10.2: ‘Sikhissa bhikkhave bhagavato arahato sammā-sambuddhassa tayo sāvakānaṃ sannipātā ahesuṃ. Eko sāvakānaṃ sannipāto ahosi bhikkhu-sata- sahassaṃ . Eko sāvakānaṃ sannipāto ahosi asītiṃ bhikkhu-sahassāni. Eko sāvakānaṃ sannipāto ahosi sattati bhikkhusahassāni. Sikhissa bhikkhave bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa ime tayo sāvakānaṃ sannipātā ahesuṃ sabbesaṃ yeva khīṇāsavānaṃ.
dn14:1.10.3: ‘Vessabhussa bhikkhave bhagavato arahato sammā-sambuddhassa tayo sāvakānaṃ sannipātā ahesuṃ. Eko sāvakānaṃ sannipāto ahosi asītiṃ bhikkhu-sahassāni. Eko sāvakānaṃ sannipāto ahosi sattati bhikkhu-sahassāni. Eko sāvakānaṃ sannipāto ahosi saṭṭhi bhikkhu-sahassāni. Vessabhussa bhikkhave bhagavato arahato sammā-sambuddhassa ime tayo sāvakānaṃ sannipātā ahesuṃ sabbesaṃ yeva khīṇāsavānaṃ.
dn14:1.10.4: ‘Kakusandhassa bhikkhave bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa eko sāvakānaṃ sannipāto ahosi cattārīsaṃ bhikkhu-sahassāni. Kakusandhassa bhikkhave bhagavato arahato sammā-sambuddhassa ayaṃ eko sāvakānaṃ sannipāto ahosi sabbesaṃ yeva khīṇāsavānaṃ.
dn14:1.10.5: ‘Konāgamanassa bhikkhave bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa eko sāvakānaṃ sannipāto ahosi tiṃsa bhikkhu-sahassāni. Konāgamanassa bhikkhave bhagavato arahato sammā-sambuddhassa ayaṃ eko sāvakānaṃ sannipāto ahosi sabbesaṃ yeva khīṇāsavānaṃ.
dn14:1.10.6: ‘Kassapassa bhikkhave Bhagavato arahato sammā-sambuddhassa eko sāvakānaṃ sannipāto ahosi vīsatiṃ bhikkhu-sahassāni. Kassapassa bhikkhave bhagavato arahato sammā-sambuddhassa ayaṃ eko sāvakānaṃ sannipāto ahosi sabbesaṃ yeva khīṇāsavānaṃ.
dn14:1.10.7: ‘Mayhaṃ bhikkhave etarahi eko sāvakānaṃ sannipāto ahosi aḍḍha-teḷasāni bhikkhu-satāni. Mayhaṃ bhikkhave ayaṃ eko sāvakānaṃ sannipāto ahosi sabbesaṃ yeva khīṇāsavānaṃ . 11.
dn14:1.11.1: ‘Vipassissa bhikkhave bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa Asoko nāma bhikkhu upaṭṭhāko ahosi aggupaṭṭhāko.
dn14:1.11.2: Sikhissa bhikkhave bhagavato arahato sammā-sambuddhassa Khemaṃkaro nāma bhikkhu upaṭṭhāko ahosi aggupaṭṭhāko.
dn14:1.11.3: Vessabhussa bhikkhave bhagavato arahato sammā-sambuddhassa Upasannako nāma bhikkhu upaṭṭhāko ahosi aggupaṭṭhāko.
dn14:1.11.4: Kakusandhassa bhikkhave bhagavato arahato sammā-sambuddhassa Buddhijo nāma bhikkhu upaṭṭhāko ahosi aggupaṭṭhāko.
dn14:1.11.5: Konāgamanassa bhikkhave bhagavato arahato sammā-sambuddhassa Sotthijo nāma bhikkhu upaṭṭhāko ahosi aggupaṭṭhāko.
dn14:1.11.6: Kassapassa bhikkhave bhagavato arahato sammā-sambuddhassa Sabbamitto nāma bhikkhu upaṭṭhāko ahosi aggupaṭṭhāko.
dn14:1.11.7: Mayhaṃ bhikkhave etarahi Ānando bhikkhu upaṭṭhāko aggupaṭṭhāko. 12.
dn14:1.12.1: ‘Vipassissa bhikkhave bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa Bandhumā nāma rājā pitā ahosi,
dn14:1.12.2: Bandhumatī nāma devī mātā ahosi janettī.
dn14:1.12.3: Bandhumassa rañño Bandhumatī nāma nagaraṃ rāja-dhānī ahosi.
dn14:1.12.4: ‘Sikhissa bhikkhave bhagavato arahato sammā-sambuddhassa Aruṇo nāma rājā pitā ahosi,
dn14:1.12.5: Pabhāvatī nāma devī mātā ahosi janettī.
dn14:1.12.6: Aruṇāssa rañño Aruṇavatī nāma nagaraṃ rāja-dhānī ahosi.
dn14:1.12.7: ‘Vessabhussa bhikkhave bhagavato arahato sammā-sambuddhassa Suppatīto nāma rājā pitā ahosi,
dn14:1.12.8: Yasavatī nāma devī mātā ahosi janettī.
dn14:1.12.9: Suppatītassa rañño Anopamaṃ nāma nagaraṃ rāja-dhānī ahosi.
dn14:1.12.10: ‘Kakusandhassa bhikkhave bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa Aggidatto nāma Brāhmaṇo pitā ahosi,
dn14:1.12.11: Visākhā nāma Brāhmaṇī mātā ahosi janettī.
dn14:1.12.12: Tena kho pana bhikkhave samayena Khemo nāma rāja ahosi.
dn14:1.12.13: Khemassa rañño Khemavavatī nāma nagaraṃ rājā-dhānī ahosi.
dn14:1.12.14: ‘Konāgamanassa bhikkhave bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa Yaññadatto nāma Brāhmaṇo pitā ahosi,
dn14:1.12.15: Uttarā nāma Brāhmaṇī mātā ahosi janettī.
dn14:1.12.16: Tena kho pana bhikkhave samayena Sobho nāma rājā ahosi.
dn14:1.12.17: Sobhassa rañño Sobhavatī nāma nagaraṃ rājā-dhānī ahosi.
dn14:1.12.18: ‘Kassapassa bhikkhave bhagavato arahato sammā-sambuddhassa Brahmadatto nāma Brāhmaṇo pitā ahosi,
dn14:1.12.19: Dhanavatī nāma Brāhmaṇī mātā ahosi janettī.
dn14:1.12.20: Tena kho pana bhikkhave samayena Kikī nāma rājā ahosi.
dn14:1.12.21: Kikissa rañño Bārāṇasī nāma nagaraṃ rājā-dhānī ahosi.
dn14:1.12.22: ‘Mayhaṃ bhikkhave etarahi Suddhodano nāma rājā pitā ahosi,
dn14:1.12.26: Idaṃ vatvā Sugato uṭṭhāy' āsanā vihāraṃ pāvisi. 13.
dn14:1.13.1: Atha kho tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ acira-pakkantassa Bhagavato ayam antarā kathā udapādi:
dn14:1.13.2: ‘Acchariyaṃ āvuso abbhutaṃ āvuso Tathāgatassa mahiddhikatā mahānubhāvatā,
dn14:1.13.3: yatra hi nāma Tathāgato atīte Buddhe parinibbute chinna-papañce chinna-vaṭume pariyādinna-vaṭṭe sabba-dukkha-vītivatte jātito pi anussarissati, nāmato pi anussarissati, gottato pi anussarissati, āyuppamāṇato pi anussarissati, sāvaka-yugato pi anussarissati, sāvaka-sannipātato pi anussarissati --
dn14:1.13.4: "Evaṃjaccā te Bhagavanto ahesuṃ iti pi, evaṃ-nāmā evaṃ-gottā evaṃ-sīlā evaṃ-dhammā evaṃ-pañña evaṃ-vihārī evaṃvimuttā te Bhagavato ahesuṃ iti pīti."
dn14:1.13.5: Kin nu kho āvuso? Tathāgatass' eva nu kho esā dhamma-dhātu suppaṭividdhā yassā dhamma-dhātuyā suppaṭividdhattā Tathāgato atīte Buddhe parinibbute chinna-papañce chinna-vaṭume pariyādinna-vaṭṭe sabba-dukkha-vītivatte jātito pi anussarati, nāmato pi anussarati, gottato pi anussarati, āyuppamāṇato pi anussarati, sāvaka-yugato pi anussarati, sāvaka-sannipātato pi anussarati "Evaṃjaccā te Bhagavanto ahesuṃ iti pi, evaṃ-nāmā, evaṃgottā, evaṃ-sīlā, evaṃ-dhammā, evaṃ-paññā, evaṃ-vihārī, evaṃ-vimuttā te Bhagavanto ahesuṃ iti pīti"?
dn14:1.13.6: Udāhu devatā Tathāgatassa etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ yena Tathāgato atīte Buddhe parinibbute chinna-papañce chinna-vaṭume pariyādinna-vaṭṭe sabba-dukkha-vītivatte jātito pi anussarati, nāmato pi anussarati, gottato pi anussarati, āyuppamāṇato pi anussarati, sāvaka-yugato pi anussarati, sāvaka-sannipātato pi anussarati: "Evaṃ-jaccā te Bhagavanto ahesuṃ iti pi, evaṃ-nāmā evaṃ-gottā evaṃsītā evaṃ-dhammā evaṃ-paññā evaṃ-vihārī evaṃvimuttā te Bhagavanto ahesuṃ iti pīti"?'
dn14:1.13.7: Ayañ ca h' idaṃ tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ antarā kathā vippakatā hoti. 14.
dn14:1.14.1: Atha kho Bhagavā sāyaṇhā-samayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito yena Kareri-maṇḍala-māḷo ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
dn14:1.14.3: ‘Kāya nu 'ttha bhikkhave etarahi kathāya sannisinnā, kā ca pana vo antarā kathā vippakatā ti?'
dn14:1.14.4: Evaṃ vutte te bhikkhū Bhagavantaṃ etad avocuṃ:
dn14:1.14.5: ‘Idha bhante amhākaṃ acira-pakkantassa Bhagavato ayaṃ antarā kathā udapādi:
dn14:1.14.6: "Acchariyaṃ āvuso abbhutaṃ āvuso Tathāgatassa mahiddhikata mahānubhāvātā,
dn14:1.14.7: yatra hi nāma Tathāgato atīte Buddhe parinibbute chinna-papañce chinna-vaṭume pariyādinna-vaṭṭe sabbadukkha-vītivatte jātito pi anussarati, nāmato pi anussarati, gottato pi anussarati, āyuppamāṇato pi anussarati, sāvakayugato pi anussarati, sāvaka-sannipātato pi anussarati:
dn14:1.14.8: ‘Evaṃ-jaccā te Bhagavanto ahesuṃ iti pi, evaṃ-nāmā, evaṃ-gottā, evaṃ-sīlā, evaṃ-dhammā, evaṃ-paññā, evaṃvihāri, evaṃ-vimuttā te Bhagavanto ahesuṃ iti pīti."
dn14:1.14.9: Kin nu kho āvuso? Tathāgatass' eva nu kho esā dhammadhātu suppaṭividdhā yassā dhamma-dhātuyā suppaṭividdhattā Tathāgato atīte Buddhe parinibbute chinnapapañce chinna-vaṭume pariyādinna-vaṭṭe sabba-dukkhavītivatte jātito pi anussarati, nāmato pi anussarati, gottato pi anussarati, āyuppamāṇato pi anussarati, sāvaka-yugato pi anussarati, sāvaka-sannipātato pi anussarati:
dn14:1.14.10: Evaṃjaccā te Bhagavanto ahesuṃ iti pi, evaṃ-nāmā, evaṃ gottā , evaṃ-sīlā, evaṃ-dhammā, evaṃ-paññā, evaṃvihāri, evaṃ-vimuttā te Bhagavanto ahesuṃ iti pīti"?
dn14:1.14.11: Udāhu devatā Tathāgatassa etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ yena Tathāgato atīte Buddhe parinibbute chinna-papañce chinna-vaṭume pariyādinna-vaṭṭe sabba-dukkha-vītivatte jātito pi anussarati, nāmato pi anussarati, gottato pi anussarati, āyuppamāṇato pi anussarati, sāvaka-yugato pi anussarati, sāvaka-sannipātato pi anussarati:
dn14:1.14.12: Evaṃjaccā te Bhagavanto ahesuṃ iti pi, evaṃ-nāmā evaṃ-gottā evaṃ-sīlā evaṃ-dhammā evaṃ-paññā evaṃvihārī evaṃ-vimuttā te Bhagavanto ahesuṃ iti pīti"?'
dn14:1.14.13: ‘Ayaṃ kho no bhante antarā kathā vippakatā atha bhagavā anuppatto ti.' 15.
dn14:1.15.1: ‘Tathāgatass' ev' esā bhikkhave dhamma-dhāti suppaṭividdhā yassā dhamma-dhātuyā suppaṭividdhattā Tathāgato atīte Buddhe parinibbute chinna-papañce chinna-vaṭume pariyādinna-vaṭṭe sabba-dukkha-vītivatte jātito pi anussarati, nāmato pi anussarati, gottato pi anussarati, āyuppamāṇato pi anussarati, sāvaka-yugato pi anussarati, sāvaka-sannipātato pi anussarati:
dn14:1.15.2: "Evaṃjaccā te Bhagavanto ahesuṃ iti pi, evaṃ-nāmā, evaṃgottā, evaṃ-sīlā, evaṃ-dhammā, evaṃ-paññā, evaṃ-vihārī, evaṃ-vimuttā te Bhagavanto ahesuṃ iti pīti."
dn14:1.15.3: Devatā pi Tathāgatassa etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ yena Tathāgato atīte Buddhe parinibbute chinna-papañce chinna-vaṭume pariyādinna-vaṭṭe sabba-dukkha-vītivatte jātito pi anussarati, nāmato pi anussarati, gottato pi anussarati, āyuppamāṇato pi anussarati, sāvaka-yugato pi anussarati, sāvaka-sannipātato pi anussarati:
dn14:1.15.4: "Evaṃ-jāccā te Bhagavanto ahesuṃ iti pi, evaṃ-nāmā, evaṃ-gottā, evaṃsīlā, evaṃ-dhammā, evaṃ-paññā,evaṃ-vihārī, evaṃvimuttā te Bhagavanto ahesuṃ iti pīti."
dn14:1.15.5: ‘Iccheyyātha no tumhe bhikkhave bhiyyoso mattāya pubbe-nivāsa-paṭisaṃyuttaṃ dhamimiṃ kathaṃ sotun ti?'
dn14:1.15.7: Yaṃ Bhagavā bhiyyoso mattāya pubbe-nivāsa-paṭisaṃyuttaṃ dhammiṃ kathaṃ kareyya, Bhagavato sutvā bhikkhū dhāressantīti.'
dn14:1.15.8: ‘Tena hi bhikkhave suṇātha, sādhukaṃ manasikarotha, bhāsissāmīti.'
dn14:1.15.9: ‘Evaṃ bhante' ti kho te bhikkhū Bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
dn14:1.16.1: ‘Ito so bhikkhave eka-navuto kappo yaṃ Vipassī bhagavā arahaṃ sammā-sambuddho loke udapādi.
dn14:1.16.2: Vipassī bhikkhave bhagavā arahaṃ sammā-sambuddho khattiyo jātiyā ahosi, khattiya-kule udapādi.
dn14:1.16.3: Vipassī bhikkhave bhagavā arahaṃ sammā-sambuddho Koṇḍañño gottena ahosi.
dn14:1.16.4: Vipassissa bhikkhave bhagavato arahato sammā-sambuddhassa asīti-vassa-sahassāni āyuppamāṇaṃ ahosi.
dn14:1.16.5: Vipassī bhikkhave bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho pāṭaliyā mūle abhisambuddho.
dn14:1.16.6: Vipassissa bhikkhave bhagavato arahato sammā-sambuddhassa Khaṇḍa-Tissaṃ nāma sāvaka-yugaṃ ahosi aggaṃ bhadda-yugaṃ.
dn14:1.16.7: Vipassissa bhikkhave bhagavato arahato sammā-sambuddhassa tayo sāvakānaṃ sannipātā ahesuṃ.
dn14:1.16.8: Eko sāvakānaṃ sannipāto ahosi aṭṭha-saṭṭhi-bhikkhusata-sahassaṃ. Eko sāvakānaṃ sannipāto ahosi bhikkhusata-sahassaṃ. Eko sāvakānaṃ sannipāto ahosi asīti bhikkhu-sahassāni .
dn14:1.16.9: Vipassissa bhikkhave bhagavato arahato sammā-sambuddhassa ime tayo sāvakānaṃ sannipātā ahesuṃ sabbesaṃ yeva khīṇāsavānaṃ.
dn14:1.16.10: Vipassissa bhikkhave bhagavato arahato sammā-sambuddhassa Asoko nāma bhikkhu upaṭṭhāko ahosi aggupaṭṭhāko.
dn14:1.16.11: Vipassissa bhikkhave bhagavato arahato sammā-saṃbuddhassa Bandhumā nāma rājā pitā ahosi,
dn14:1.16.12: Bandhumatī nāma devī mātā ahosi janettī.
dn14:1.16.13: Bandhumassa rañño Bandhumatī nāma nagaraṃ rāja-dhānī ahosi. 17.
dn14:1.17.1: ‘Atha kho bhikkhave Vipassī Bodhisatto Tusitā kāyā cavitvā sato sampajāno mātu-kucchiṃ okkami.
dn14:1.17.3: ‘Dhammatā esā bhikkhave, yadā Bodhisatto Tusitā kāyā cavitvā mātu kucchiṃ okkamati
dn14:1.17.4: atha sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇa-brāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadeva-manussāya appamāṇo uḷāro obbāso pātubhavati atikkamma devānaṃ devānubhāvaṃ.
dn14:1.17.5: Yā pi tā lokantarikā aghā asaṃvutā andhakārā andhakāra-timisā, yāttha pi 'me candima-suriyā evaṃ mahiddhikā evaṃ mahānubhāvā ābhāya nānubhonti, tattha pi appamāṇo uḷāro obhāso pātubhavati atikkamm' eva devānaṃ devānubhāvaṃ.
dn14:1.17.6: Ye pi tattha sattā upapannā, te pi ten' obhāsena aññaṃ aññaṃ sañjānanti: "Aññe pi kira bho santi sattā idhūpapannā ti."
dn14:1.17.7: Ayañ ca dasa-sahassī lokadhātu saṃkampati sampakampati sampavedhati. Appamāṇo ca uḷāro obhāso loke pātubhavati atikkamm' eva devānaṃ devānubhāvaṃ.
dn14:1.17.9: ‘Dhammatā esā bhikkhave, yadā Bodhisatto mātu kucchiṃ okkanto hoti, cattāro naṃ deva-puttā catuddisaṃ rakkhāya upagacchanti: "Mātaṃ Bodhisattaṃ vā Bodhisatta-mātaraṃ vā manusso vā amanusso vā koci vā viheṭhesīti."
dn14:1.18.1: ‘Dhammatā esā bhikkhave, yadā Bodhisatto mātu kucchiṃ okkanto hoti, pakatiyā sīlavatī Bodhisatta-mātā hoti, viratā pāṇātipātā, viratā adinnādānā, viratā kāmesu micchācārā, viratā musā-vādā, viratā surā-meraya-majjapamādaṭṭhānā.
dn14:1.19.1: ‘Dhammatā esā bhikkhave, yadā Bodhisatto mātu kucchiṃ okkanto hoti, na Bodhisatta-mātu purisesu mānasaṃ uppajjati kāma-guṇūpasaṃhitaṃ, anatikkamaniyā ca Bodhisatta-mātā hoti kenaci purisena rattacittena.
dn14:1.20.1: ‘Dhammatā esā bhikkhave, yadā Bodhisatto mātu kucchiṃ okkanto hoti, lābhinī Bodhisatta-mātā hoti pañcannaṃ kāma-guṇānaṃ, sā pañcahi kāma-guṇehi samappitā samaṅgibhūtā parivāreti.
dn14:1.21.1: ‘Dhammatā esā bhikkhave, yadā Bodhisatto mātu kucchiṃ okkanto hoti, na Bodhisatta-mātu kocid eva ābādho uppajjati, sukhinī Bodhisatta-mātā hoti akilantakāyā, Bodhisattañ ca Bodhisatta-mātā tiro-kucchi-gataṃ passati sabbaṅga-paccaṅgiṃ abhinindriyaṃ.
dn14:1.21.2: ‘Seyyathā pi bhikkhave maṇi veḷuriyo subho jātimā aṭṭhaṃso suparikamma-kato accho vippasanno sabbākārasampanno. Tatra 'ssa suttaṃ āvutaṃ nīlaṃ vā pītaṃ vā lohitaṃ vā odātaṃ vā paṇḍu-suttaṃ vā.
dn14:1.21.3: Tam enaṃ cakkhumā puriso hatthe karitvā paccavekkheyya : "Ayaṃ kho maṇi veḷuriyo subho jātimā aṭṭhaṃso suparikamma-kato accho vippasanno sabbākāra-sampanno Tatr' idaṃ suttaṃ āvutaṃ nīlaṃ vā pītaṃ vā lohitaṃ vā odātaṃ vā paṇḍu-suttaṃ vā ti."
dn14:1.21.4: Evam eva kho bhikkhave yadā Bodhisatto mātu kucchiṃ okkanto hoti, na Bodhisatta-mātu kocid eva ābādho uppajjati, sukhinī Bodhisatta-mātā hoti akilanta-kāyā, Bodhisattañ ca Bodhisatta-mātā tiro-kucchi-gataṃ passati sabbaṅgapaccaṅgiṃ abhinindriyaṃ.
dn14:1.22.1: ‘Dhammatā esā bhikkhave, sattāha-jāte Bodhisatte Bodhisatta-mātā kālaṃ karoti, Tusitaṃ kāyaṃ uppajjati.
dn14:1.23.1: ‘Dhammatā esā bhikkhave, yathā aññā itthikā nava vā dasa vā māse gabbhaṃ kucchinā pariharitvā vijāyanti, na h' evaṃ Bodhisattaṃ Bodhisatta-mātā vijāyati, das eva māsāni Bodhisattaṃ Bodhisatta-mātā kucchinā pariharitvā vijāyati.
dn14:1.24.1: ‘Dhammatā esā bhikkhave, yathā aññā itthikā nisinnā vā nipannā vā vijāyanti, na h' evaṃ Bodhisattaṃ Bodhisatta-mātā vijāyati, ṭhitā va Bodhisattaṃ Bodhisattamātā vijāyati.
dn14:1.25.1: ‘Dhammatā esā bhikkhave, yadā Bodhisatto mātu kucchismā nikkhamati, devā paṭhamaṃ paṭiggaṇhanti, pacchā manussā.
dn14:1.26.1: ‘Dhammatā esā bhikkhave, yadā Bodhisatto mātu kucchismā nikkhamati appatto va Bodhisatto paṭhaviṃ hoti, cattāro naṃ deva-puttā paṭiggahetvā mātu purato ṭhapenti: "Attamanā devī hohi, Mahesakkho te putto uppanno ti."
dn14:1.27.1: ‘Dhammatā esā bhikkhave, yadā Bodhisatto mātu kucchismā nikkhamati, visado va nikkhamati, amakkhito uddena amakkhito semhena amakkhito ruhirena amakkhito kenaci asucinā, suddho visado.
dn14:1.27.2: ‘Seyyathā pi bhikkhave maṇi-ratanaṃ Kāsike vatthe nikkhittaṃ, n' eva maṇi-ratanaṃ Kāsikaṃ vatthaṃ makkheti, na pi Kāsikaṃ vatthaṃ maṇi-ratanaṃ makkheti
dn14:1.27.5: evam eva kho bhikkhave yadā Bodhisatto mātu kucchismā nikkhamati, visado va nikkhamati, amakkhito uddena amakkhito semhena amakkhito ruhirena amakkhito kenaci asucinā, suddho visado.
dn14:1.28.1: ‘Dhammatā esā bhikkhave. Yadā Bodhisatto mātu kucchismā nikkhamati, dve udakassa dhārā antalikkhā pātubhavanti, ekā sītassa ekā uṇhassa, yena Bodhisattassa udaka-kiccaṃ karonti mātucca.
dn14:1.29.1: ‘Dhammatā esā bhikkhave. Sampati-jāto Bodhisatto samehi pādehi patiṭṭhahitvā uttarābhimukho satvapada-vītihārena gacchati, setamhi chatte anuhīramāne sabbā ca disā viloketi āsabhiñ ca vācaṃ bhāsati: "Aggo 'ham asmi lokassa, jeṭṭho 'ham asmi lokkassa, seṭṭho 'ham asmi lokassa, ayam anitimā jāti, n' atthi dāni punabbhavo ti."
dn14:1.30.1: ‘Dhammatā esā bhikkhave. Yadā Bodhisatto mātu kucchismā nikkhamati, atha sadevake loke sammārake sabrahmake sassamaṇa-brāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya appamāṇo uḷāro obhāso pātubhavati, atikkamm' eva devānaṃ devānubhāvaṃ.
dn14:1.30.2: Yā pi tā lokantarikā aghā asaṃvutā andhakārā andhakārā-timisā, yattha pi 'me candima-suriyā evaṃ mahiddhikā evaṃ mahānubhāvā ābhāya nānubhonti, tattha pi appamāṇo uḷāro obhāso pātubhavati atikkamm' eva devānaṃ devānubhāvaṃ.
dn14:1.30.3: Ye pi tattha sattā upapannā, te pi ten' obhāsena aññam aññaṃ sañjānanti: "Aññe pi kira bho santi sattā idhūpapannā ti."
dn14:1.30.4: Ayañ ca dasa-sahassī lokadhātu saṃkampati sampakampati sampavedhati. Appamāṇo ca uḷāro obhāso loke pātubhavati atikkamm, eva devānaṃ devānubhāvaṃ.
dn14:1.31.1: ‘Jāte kho pana bhikkhave Vipassimhi kumāre, Bandhumato rañño paṭivedesuṃ:
dn14:1.31.2: "Putto te deva jāto, taṃ devo passatūti."
dn14:1.31.3: Addasā kho bhikkhave Bandhumā rājā Vipassī-kumāraṃ, disvā nemitte brāhmaṇe āmantāpetvā etad avoca:
dn14:1.31.4: Passantu bhonto nemittā brāhmaṇā kumāran ti."
dn14:1.31.5: Addasāsuṃ kho bhikkhave nemittā brāhmaṇā Vipassī-kumāraṃ, disvā Bandhumaṃ rājānaṃ etad avocuṃ:
dn14:1.31.6: "Attamano deva hohi, mahesakkho te deva putto uppanno. Lābhā te Mahārāja, suladdhaṃ te Mahārāja, yassa te kule evarūpo putto uppanno.
dn14:1.31.7: Ayaṃ hi deva kumāro dvattiṃsa Mahāpurisa-lakkhaṇehi samannāgato, yehi samannāgatassa Mahāpurisassa dve gatiyo bhavanti anaññā.
dn14:1.31.8: Sace agāraṃ ajjhāvasati, rājā hoti cakka-vatti dhammiko dhamma-rājā cāturanto vijitāvī janapadatthāvariyappatto satta-ratana-samannāgato.
dn14:1.31.10: seyyathīdaṃ cakkaratanaṃ hatthi-ratanaṃ assa-ratanaṃ maṇi-ratanaṃ itthiratanaṃ gahapati-ratanaṃ pariṇāyaka-ratanam eva sattamaṃ.
dn14:1.31.11: Paro- sahassaṃ kho pan' assa puttā bhavanti sūrā vīraṅga-rūpā parasenappamaddanā.
dn14:1.31.12: So imaṃ paṭhaviṃ sāgara-pariyantaṃ adaṇḍena asatthena dhammena abhivijiya ajjhāvasati.
dn14:1.31.13: Sace kho pana agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajati, arahaṃ hoti sammā-sambuddho loke vivattacchaddo. 32.
dn14:1.32.1: "‘Katamehi cāyaṃ deva kumāro dvattiṃsa Mahāpurisa-lakkhaṇehi samannāgato yehi samannāgatassa Mahāpurisassa dve gatiyo bhavanti anaññā?
dn14:1.32.2: Sace agāraṃ ajjhāvasati, rājā hoti cakka-vatti dhammiko dhamma-rājā cāturanto vijitāvī janapadatthāvariyappatto satta-ratana-samannāgato.
dn14:1.32.4: seyyathīdaṃ cakka-ratanaṃ hatthi-ratanaṃ assa-ratanaṃ maṇi-ratanaṃ itthi-ratanaṃ gahapatiratanaṃ pariṇāyaka-ratanam eva sattamaṃ.
dn14:1.32.5: Paro- sahassaṃ kho pan' assa puttā bhavanti sūrā vīraṅga-rūpā parasenappamaddanā.
dn14:1.32.6: So imaṃ paṭhaviṃ sāgarapariyantaṃ adaṇḍena asatthena dhammena abhivijiya ajjhāvasati.
dn14:1.32.7: Sace kho pana agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajati, arahaṃ hoti sammā- sambuddho loke vivattacchaddo. "‘Ayaṃ hi deva kumāro suppatiṭṭhita-pādo. Yam pāyaṃ deva kumāro suppatiṭṭhita-pādo, idam pi 'ssa Mahāpurisassa Mahāpurisa-lakkhaṇaṃ bhavati.
dn14:1.32.8: "‘Imassa deva kumārassa heṭṭhā -pāda-talesu cakkāni jātāni sahassārāni sanemikāni sanābhikāni sabbākāraparipūrāni. Yam pi deva imassa kumārassa heṭṭhā -pādatalesu cakkāni jātāni sahassārāni sanemikāni sanābhikāni sabbākāra-paripūrāni, idam pi 'ssa Mahāpurisassa Mahāpurisa-lakkhaṇaṃ bhavati.
dn14:1.32.15: "‘Ayaṃ hi deva kumāro ṭhitako va anonamanto ubhohi pāṇi-talehi jannukāni parimasati parimajjati . . . pe . . .
dn14:1.32.17: "‘Ayaṃ hi deva kumāro suvaṇṇa-vaṇṇo kañcana sannibha-ttaco . . . pe . . .
dn14:1.32.18: "‘Ayaṃ hi deva kumāro sukhumacchavī sukhumattā chaviyā rajojallaṃ kāye na upalimpati . . . pe . . .
dn14:1.32.19: "‘Ayaṃ hi deva kumāro ekeka-lomo ekekāni lomāni loma-kūpesu jātāni . . . pe . . .
dn14:1.32.20: "‘Ayaṃ hi deva kumāro uddhagga-lomo uddhaggāni lomāni jātāni nīlāni añjana-vaṇṇāni kuṇḍala-vattāni dakkhiṇāvattaka-jātāni . . . pe . . .
dn14:1.32.25: "‘Ayaṃ hi deva kumāro nigrodha-parimaṇḍalo, yāvatakv assa kāyo tāvatakvassa vyāmo, yāvatakv assa vyāmo tāvatakvassa kāyo . . . pe . . .
dn14:1.32.34: "‘Ayaṃ hi deva kumāro Brahmassaro karavīka-bhāṇī . . . pe . . .
dn14:1.32.37: "‘Imassa deva kumārassa uṇṇā bhamukantare jātā odātā mudu-tūla-sannibhā. Yam pi deva imassa kumārassa uṇṇā bhamukantare jātā odātā mudu-tūla-sannibhā, idam pi 'ssa Mahāpurisassa Mahāpurisa-lakkhaṇaṃ bhavati.
dn14:1.32.38: "‘Ayaṃ hi deva kumāro uṇhīsa-sīso. Yam pāyaṃ deva kumāro uṇhīsa-sīso, idam pi 'ssa Mahāpurisassa Mahāpurisa-lakkhaṇaṃ bhavati. 33.
dn14:1.33.1: "‘Imehi kho ayaṃ deva kumāro dvattiṃsa Mahāpurisa-lakkhaṇehi samannāgato, yehi samannāgatassa Mahāpurisassa dve gatiyo bhavanti anaññā.
dn14:1.33.2: Sace agāraṃ ajjhāvasati, rājā hoti cakkavatti dhammiko dhamma-rājā cāturanto vijitāvī janapadatthāvariyappatto satta-ratanasamannāgato.
dn14:1.33.4: seyyathīdaṃ cakka-ratanaṃ hatthi-ratanaṃ assa-ratanaṃ maṇi-ratanaṃ itthi-ratanaṃ gahapati-ratanaṃ pariṇāyakaratanam eva sattamaṃ.
dn14:1.33.5: Paro-sahassaṃ kho pan' assa puttā bhavanti sūrā vīraṅga-rūpā parasenappamaddanā .
dn14:1.33.6: So imaṃ paṭhaviṃ sāgara-pariyantaṃ adaṇḍena asatthena dhammena abhivijiya ajjhāvasati.
dn14:1.33.7: Sace kho pana agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajati, arahaṃ hoti sammā- sambuddho loke vivattacchaddo ti."
dn14:1.33.9: ‘Atha kho bhikkhave Bandhumā rājā nemitte brāhmaṇe ahatehi vatthehi acchādāpetvā sabba-kāmehi santappesi. 34.
dn14:1.34.1: ‘Atha kho bhikkhave Bandhumā rājā Vipassissa kumārassa dhātiyo upaṭṭhāpesi.
dn14:1.34.2: Aññā sudaṃ pāyenti, aññā nahāpenti, aññā dhārenti, aññā aṅkena pariharanti.
dn14:1.34.3: Jātassa kho pana bhikkhave Vipassissa kumārassa setacchattaṃ dhārayittha divā c' eva rattiñ ca:
dn14:1.34.4: "mā naṃ sītaṃ vā uṇhaṃ vā tiṇaṃ vā rajo vā ussāvo vā bādhā ti."
dn14:1.34.5: Jāto kho pana bhikkhave Vipassī kumāro bahuno janassa piyo ahosi manāpo.
dn14:1.34.6: Seyyathā pi bhikkhave uppalaṃ vā padumaṃ vā puṇḍarīkaṃ vā bahuno janassa piyaṃ manāpaṃ,
dn14:1.34.7: evam eva kho bhikkhave Vipassī kumāro bahuno janassa piyo ahosi manāpo.
dn14:1.35.1: ‘Jāto kho pana bhikkhave Vipassī kumāro mañjussaro ca ahosi vaggu-ssaro ca madhura-ssaro ca pemanīya-ssaro ca.
dn14:1.35.2: Seyyathā pi bhikkhave Himavante pabbate karavīkā nāma sakuṇa-jāti mañjussarā ca vaggu- madhura-ssarā ca pemanīyassarā ca,
dn14:1.35.3: evam eva kho bhikkhave Vipassī kumāro mañjussaro ca ahosi vaggu-ssaro ca madhurassaro ca pemanīyassaro ca. 36.
dn14:1.36.1: ‘Jātassa kho pana bhikkhave Vipassissa kumārassa kamma-vipākajaṃ dibbaṃ cakkhuṃ pātur ahosi, yena sudaṃ samantā yojanaṃ passati divā c' eva rattiñ ca. 37.
dn14:1.37.1: ‘Jāto kho pana bhikkhave Vipassī kumāro animisanto pekkhati, seyyathā pi devā Tāvatiṃsā.
dn14:1.37.2: "Animisanto kumāro pekkhatīti" kho bhikkhave Vipassissa kumārassa "Vipassī Vipassī" tveva samaññā udapādi.
dn14:1.37.3: Atha kho bhikkhave Bandhumā rājā attha-karaṇe nisinno, Vipassi-kumāraṃ aṅke nisīdāpetvā atthe anusāsati.
dn14:1.37.4: Tatra sudaṃ bhikkhave Vipassī kumāro pitu aṅke nisinno viceyya viceyya atthe panāyati ñāyena.

dn14:2.16.2: "Vipassī kira kumāro kesa-massuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito ti."
dn14:2.16.4: "Na hi nūna so orako dhammavinayo, na sā orikā pabbajjā, yattha Vipassī kumāro kesa-massuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito.
dn14:2.16.5: Vipassī pi nāma kumāro kesa-massuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajissati, kim aṅga pana na mayan ti?"
dn14:2.16.6: Atha kho so bhikkhave mahā-janakāyo caturāsīti-pāṇa-sahassāni kesa-massuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā Vipassiṃ Bodhisattaṃ agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitaṃ anupabbajiṃsu.
dn14:2.16.7: Tāya sudaṃ bhikkhave parisāya parivuto Vipassī Bodhisatto gāma-nigama-rājadhānīsu cārikaṃ carati. 17.
dn14:2.17.1: ‘Atha kho bhikkhave Vipassissa Bodhisatassa rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi:
dn14:2.17.2: "‘Na kho me taṃ paṭirūpaṃ yo 'haṃ ākiṇṇo viharāmi. Yan nūnāhaṃ eko gaṇasmā vūpakaṭṭho vihareyyan ti."
dn14:2.17.3: ‘Atha kho bhikkhave Vipassī Bodhisatto aparena samayena eko gaṇasmā vūpakaṭṭho vihāsi. Aññen' eva tāni caturāsīti- pabbajita -sahassāni agamaṃsu, aññena Vipassī Bodhisatto. 18.
dn14:2.18.1: ‘Atha kho bhikkhave Vipassissa Bodhisattassa vāsupagatassa rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi:
dn14:2.18.2: "‘Kicchaṃ vatāyam loko āpanno, jāyati ca jīyati ca mīyati ca cavati ca uppajjati ca. Atha ca pan' imassa dukkhassa nissaraṇaṃ nappajānāti jarā-maraṇassa,
dn14:2.18.3: kudāssu nāma imassa dukkhassa nissaraṇaṃ paññāyissati jarāmaraṇassāti?"
dn14:2.18.4: ‘Atha kho bhikkhave Vipassissa Bodhisattassa etad ahosi:
dn14:2.18.5: "Kimhi nu kho sati jarā-maraṇaṃ hoti, kim-paccayā jarā-maraṇan ti?"
dn14:2.18.6: Atha kho bhikkhave Vipassissa Bodhisattassa yoniso-manasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo:
dn14:2.18.7: "Jātiyā kho sati jarā-maraṇaṃ hoti, jātipaccayā jarā-maraṇan ti."
dn14:2.18.8: ‘Atha kho bhikkhave Vipassissa Bodhisattassa etad ahosi:
dn14:2.18.9: "Kimhi nu kho sati jāti hoti, kim-paccayā jātīti?"
dn14:2.18.10: Atha kho bhikkhave Vipassissa Bodhisattassa yonisomanasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo:
dn14:2.18.11: "Bhave kho sati jāti hoti bhava-paccayā jātīti."
dn14:2.18.12: ‘Atha kho bhikkhave Vipassissa Bodhisattassa etad ahosi:
dn14:2.18.13: "Kimhi nu kho sati bhavo hoti, kim-paccayā bhavo ti?"
dn14:2.18.14: Atha kho bhikkhave Vipassissa Bodhisattassa yoniso-manasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo:
dn14:2.18.15: "Upādāne kho sati bhavo hoti, upādāna-paccayā bhavo ti."
dn14:2.18.16: ‘Atha kho bhikkhave Vipassissa Bodhisattassa etad ahosi:
dn14:2.18.17: "Kimhi nu kho sati upādānaṃ hoti , kim-paccayā upādānan ti?"
dn14:2.18.18: Atha kho bhikkhave Vipassissa Bodhisattassa yoniso-manasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo:
dn14:2.18.19: "Taṇhāya kho sati upādānaṃ hoti, taṇhā-paccayā upādānan ti."
dn14:2.18.20: ‘Atha kho bhikkhave Vipassissa Bodhisattassa etad ahosi:
dn14:2.18.21: "Kimhi nu kho sati taṇhā hoti, kim-paccayā taṇhā ti?"
dn14:2.18.22: Atha kho bhikkhave Vipassissa Bodhisattassa yoniso-manasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo:
dn14:2.18.23: "Vedanāya kho sati taṇhā hoti, vedanā-paccayā taṇhā ti."
dn14:2.18.24: ‘Atha kho bhikkhave Vipassissa Bodhisattassa etad ahosi:
dn14:2.18.25: "Kimhi nu kho sati vedanā hoti, kim-paccayā vedanā ti?"
dn14:2.18.26: Atha kho bhikkhave Vipassissa Bodhisattassa yoniso-manasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo:
dn14:2.18.27: "Phasse kho sati vedanā hoti, phassa-paccayā vedanā ti."
dn14:2.18.28: ‘Atha kho bhikkhave Vipassissa Bodhisattassa etad ahosi:
dn14:2.18.29: "Kimhi nu kho sati phasso hoti, kim-paccatā phasso ti?"
dn14:2.18.30: Atha kho bhikkhave Vipassissa Bodhisattassa yoniso-manasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo:
dn14:2.18.31: "Saḷāyatane kho sati phasso hoti, saḷāyatana-paccayā phasso ti?"
dn14:2.18.32: ‘Atha kho bhikkhave Vipassissa Bodhisattassa etad ahosi:
dn14:2.18.33: "Kimhi nu kho sati saḷāyatanaṃ hoti, kim-paccayā saḷāyatanan ti?"
dn14:2.18.34: Atha kho bhikkhave Vipassissa Bodhisattassa yoniso-manasikārā ahu paññaya abhisamayo:
dn14:2.18.35: "Nāme-rūpe kho sati saḷāyatanaṃ hoti, nāmarūpa paccayā saḷāyatanan ti."
dn14:2.18.36: ‘Atha kho bhikkhave Vipassissa Bodhisattassa etad ahosi:
dn14:2.18.37: "Kimhi nu kho sati nāma-rūpaṃ hoti, kim-paccayā nāma-rūpan ti?"
dn14:2.18.38: Atha kho bhikkhave Vipassissa Bodhisattassa yoniso-manasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo:
dn14:2.18.39: "Viññāṇe kho sati nāma-rūpaṃ hoti, viññāṇapaccayā nāma-rūpan ti."
dn14:2.18.40: ‘Atha kho bhikkhave Vipassissa Bodhisattassa etad ahosi:
dn14:2.18.41: "Kimhi nu kho sati viññāṇaṃ hoti, kim-paccayā viññāṇan ti?"
dn14:2.18.42: Atha kho bhikkhave Vipassissa Bodhisattassa yoniso-manasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo:
dn14:2.18.43: "Nāma-rūpe kho sati viññāṇaṃ hoti, nāmarūpa-paccayā viññāṇan ti." 19.
dn14:2.19.1: ‘Atha kho bhikkhave Vipassissa Bodhisattassa etad ahosi:
dn14:2.19.2: "Paccudāvattati kho idaṃ viññāṇaṃ nāmarūpamhā, nāparaṃ gacchati.
dn14:2.19.3: Ettāvatā jāyetha vā jīyetha vā mīyetha vā cavetha vā uppajjetha vā, yadidaṃ
dn14:2.19.4: nāmarūpa-paccayā viññāṇaṃ, viññāṇa-paccayā nāmarūpaṃ, nāmarūpa-paccayā saḷāyatanaṃ, saḷāyatana-paccayā phasso, phassa-paccayā vedanā, vedanā-paccayā taṇhā, taṇhā-paccayā upādānaṃ, upādāna-paccayā bhavo, bhava-paccayā jāti, jāti-paccayā jarā-maraṇaṃ soka-parideva-dukkha-domanass-upāyāsā sambhavanti,
dn14:2.19.5: evam etassa kevalassa dukkha-kkhandhassa samudayo hoti.
dn14:2.19.6: "‘Samudayo samudayo" ti kho bhikkhave Vipassissa Bodhisattassa pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu cakkhuṃ udapādi, nāṇaṃ udapādi, paññā udapādi, vijjā udapādi, āloko udapādi. 20.
dn14:2.20.1: ‘Atha kho bhikkhave Vipassissa Bodhisattassa etad ahosi:
dn14:2.20.2: "Kimhi nu kho asati jarā-maraṇaṃ na hoti, kissa nirodhā jarā-maraṇa-nirodho ti?"
dn14:2.20.3: Atha kho bhikkhave Vipassissa Bodhisattassa yoniso-manasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo:
dn14:2.20.4: "Jāriyā kho asati jarā-maraṇaṃ na hoti, jāti-nirodhā jarā-maraṇa-nirodho ti."
dn14:2.20.5: ‘Atha kho bhikkhave Vipassissa Bodhisattassa etad ahosi:
dn14:2.20.6: "Kimhi nu kho asati jāti na hoti, kissa nirodhā jāti-nirodho ti?"
dn14:2.20.7: Atha kho bhikkhave Vipassissa Bodhisattassa yoniso-manasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo:
dn14:2.20.8: "Bhave kho asati jāti na hoti, bhave-nirodhā jāti-nirodho ti."
dn14:2.20.9: ‘Atha kho bhikkhave Vipassissa Bodhisattassa etad ahosi:
dn14:2.20.10: "Kimhi nu kho asati bhavo na hoti, kissa nirodhā bhava-nirodho ti?"
dn14:2.20.11: Atha kho bhikkhave Vipassissa Bodhisattassa yoniso-manasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo:
dn14:2.20.12: "Upādāne kho asati bhavo na hoti, upādānanirodhā bhava-nirodho ti."
dn14:2.20.13: ‘Atha kho bhikkhave Vipassissa Bodhisattassa etad ahosi:
dn14:2.20.14: "Kimhi nu kho asati upādānaṃ na hoti, kissa nirodhā upādāna-nirodho ti?"
dn14:2.20.15: Atha kho bhikkhave Vipassissa Bodhisattassa yoniso-manasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo:
dn14:2.20.16: "Taṇhāya kho asati upādānaṃ na hoti, taṇhānirodhā upādāna-nirodho ti."
dn14:2.20.17: ‘Atha kho bhikkhave Vipassissa Bodhisattassa etad ahosi:
dn14:2.20.18: "Kimhi nu kho asati taṇhā na hoti, kissa nirodhā taṇhā-nirodho ti?"
dn14:2.20.19: Atha kho bhikkhave Vipassissa Bodhisattassa yoniso-manasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo:
dn14:2.20.20: "Vedanāya kho asati taṇhā na hoti, vedanā- nirodhā taṇhā-nirodho ti."
dn14:2.20.21: ‘Atha kho bhikkhave Vipassissa Bodhisattassa etad ahosi:
dn14:2.20.22: "Kimhi nu kho asati vedanā na hoti, kissa nirodhā vedanā-nirodho ti?"
dn14:2.20.23: Atha kho bhikkhave Vipassissa Bodhisattassa yoniso-manasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo:
dn14:2.20.24: "Phasse kho asati vedanā na hoti, phassa-nirodhā vedanā-nirodho ti."
dn14:2.20.25: ‘Atha kho bhikkhave Vipassissa Bodhisattassa etad ahosi:
dn14:2.20.26: "Kimhi nu kho asati phasso na hoti, kissa nirodhā phassa-nirodho ti?"
dn14:2.20.27: Atha kho bhikkhave Vipassissa Bodhisattassa yoniso-manasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo:
dn14:2.20.28: "Saḷāyatane kho asati phasso na hoti, saḷāyatananirodhā phassa-nirodho ti."
dn14:2.20.29: ‘Atha kho bhikkhave Vipassissa Bodhisattassa etad ahosi:
dn14:2.20.30: "Kimhi nu kho asati saḷāyatanaṃ na hoti, kissa nirodhā saḷāyatana-nirodho ti?"
dn14:2.20.31: Atha kho bhikkhave Vipassissa Bodhisattassa yoniso-manasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo:
dn14:2.20.32: "Nāma-rūpe kho asati saḷāyatanaṃ na hoti, nāma-rūpa-nirodhā saḷāyatana-nirodho ti."
dn14:2.20.33: ‘Atha kho bhikkhave Vipassissa Bodhisattassa etad ahosi:
dn14:2.20.34: "Kimhi nu kho asati nāma-rūpaṃ na hoti, kissa nirodhā nāma-rūpa-nirodho ti?"
dn14:2.20.35: Atha kho bhikkhave Vipassissa Bodhisattissa yoniso-manasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo:
dn14:2.20.36: "Viññāṇe kho asati nāma-rūpaṃ na hoti, viññāṇa-nirodhā nāma-rūpa-nirodho ti."
dn14:2.20.37: ‘Atha kho bhikkhave Vipassissa Bodhisattassa etad ahosi:
dn14:2.20.38: "Kimhi nu kho asati viññāṇaṃ na hoti, kissa nirodhā viññāṇa-nirodho ti?"
dn14:2.20.39: Atha kho bhikkhave Vipassissa Bodhisattassa yoniso-manasikārā ahu paññāya abhisamayo:
dn14:2.20.40: "Nāmarūpe kho asati viññāṇaṃ na hoti, nāmarūpa-nirodhā viññāṇa-nirodho ti " 21.
dn14:2.21.1: ‘Atha kho bhikkhave Vipassissa Bodhisattassa etad ahosi:
dn14:2.21.3: nāmarūpa-nirodhā viññāṇa-nirodho, viññāṇa-nirodhā nāmarūpa-nirodho, nāmarūpa-nirodhā saḷāyatana-nirodho, saḷāyatana-nirodhā phassa-nirodho, phassa-nirodhā vedanā-nirodho, vedanā-nirodhā taṇhānirodho, taṇhā-nirodhā upādāna-nirodho, upādāna-nirodhā bhava-nirodho, bhava-nirodhā jāti-nirodho, jāti-nirodhā jarā-maraṇaṃ soka-parideva-dukkha-domanass-upāyāsā nirujjhanti,
dn14:2.21.4: evam etassa kevalassa dukkha-kkhandhassa nirodho hoti.
dn14:2.21.5: "‘Nirodho nirodho ti" kho bhikkhave Vipassissa Bodhisattassa pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu cakkhuṃ udapādi, ñāṇaṃ udapādi, paññā udapādi, vijjā udapādi, āloko udapādi. 22.
dn14:2.22.1: ‘Atha kho bhikkhave Vipassī Bodhisatto aparena samayena pañcas' upādāna-kkhandhesu udaya-vyayānupassī vihāsi:
dn14:2.22.2: "Iti rūpaṃ, iti rūpassa samudayo, iti rūpassa atthagamo;
dn14:2.22.3: Iti vedanā, iti vedanāya samudayo, iti vedanāya atthagamo;
dn14:2.22.4: iti saññā, iti saññāya samudayo iti saññāya atthagamo;
dn14:2.22.5: iti saṃkhārā, iti saṃkhārānaṃ samudayo, iti saṃkhārānaṃ atthagamo;
dn14:2.22.6: iti viññāṇaṃ, iti viññāṇassa samudayo, iti viññāṇassa atthagamo ti."
dn14:2.22.7: ‘Tassa pañcas' upādāna- kkhandhesu udaya-vyayānupassino viharato na cirass' eva anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimucci. Dutiyaka-
dn14:3.1.1: ‘Atha kho bhikkhave Vipassissa bhagavato arahato sammā-sambuddhassa etad ahosi:
dn14:3.1.3: "Atha kho bhikkhave Vipassissa bhagavato arahato sammā-sambuddhassa etad ahosi:
dn14:3.1.4: "Adhigato kho me ayaṃ dhammo gambhīro duddaso duranubodho santo paṇīto atakkāvacaro nipuṇo paṇḍita-vedanīyo.
dn14:3.1.5: Ālayarāmā kho panāyaṃ pajā ālaya-ratā ālaya-sammuditā.
dn14:3.1.6: Ālaya-rāmāya kho pana pajāya ālaya-ratāya ālaya-sammuditāya duddasaṃ idaṃ ṭhānaṃ yadidaṃ ida-paccayatā paṭiccasamuppādo.
dn14:3.1.7: Idam pi kho ṭhānaṃ duddasaṃ, yadidaṃ sabba-saṃkhāra-samatho sabbūpadhi-paṭinissaggo taṇhakkhayo virāgo nirodho nibbānaṃ.
dn14:3.1.8: Ahañ c' eva kho pana dhammaṃ deseyyaṃ pare ca me na ājāneyyuṃ, so mam' assa kilamatho, sā mam' assa vihesā ti." 2.
dn14:3.2.1: ‘Api 'ssu bhikkhave Vipassiṃ bhagavantaṃ arahantaṃ sammā-sambuddhaṃ imā anacchariyā gāthā paṭibhaṃsu pubbe assuta-pubbā:
dn14:3.2.10: ‘Iti ha bhikkhave Vipassissa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa paṭisañcikkhato appossukkatāya cittaṃ nami no dhamma-desanāya.
dn14:3.2.11: Atha kho bhikkhave aññatarassa Mahā-brahmuno Vipassissa bhagavato arahato sammā-sambuddhassa cetasā ceto-parivitakkam aññāya etad ahosi:
dn14:3.2.12: "Nassati vata bho loko, vinassati vata bho loko, yatra hi nāma Vipassissa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa appossukkatāya cittaṃ namati, no dhamma-desanāyāti." 3.
dn14:3.2.13: ‘Atha kho so bhikkhave Mahā-brahmā, seyyathā pi nāma balavā puriso sammiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya, pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ sammiñjeyya, evam eva Brahmaloke antarahito Vipassissa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa purato pātur ahosi.
dn14:3.3.1: Atha kho so bhikkhave Mahā-brahmā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā dakkhiṇaṃ jānu-maṇḍalaṃ paṭhaviyaṃ nihantvā, yena Vipassī bhagavā arahaṃ sammā-sambuddho ten' añjaliṃ paṇāmetvā Vipassiṃ bhagavantaṃ arahantaṃ sammāsambuddhaṃ etad avoca:
dn14:3.3.2: "Desetu bhante bhagavā dhammaṃ, desetu sugato dhammaṃ,
dn14:3.3.3: santi sattā appa-rajakkha-jātikā, assavanatā dhammassa parihāyanti,
dn14:3.4.1: ‘Evaṃ vutte bhikkhave Vipassī bhagavā arahaṃ sammā-sambuddho Mahā-brahmānaṃ etad avoca:
dn14:3.4.5: ‘Adhigato kho me ayaṃ dhammo gambhīro duddaso duranubodho santo paṇīto atakkāvacaro nipuṇo paṇḍita-vedanīyo.
dn14:3.4.6: Ālaya-rāmā kho panāyaṃ pajā ālayaratā ālaya-sammuditā.
dn14:3.4.7: Ālaya-rāmāya kho pana pajāya ālaya-ratāya ālaya- sammuditāya duddasaṃ idaṃ ṭhānaṃ yadidaṃ idappaccayatā paṭiccasamuppādo .
dn14:3.4.8: Idam pi kho ṭhānam duddasaṃ, yadidam sabba-saṃkhārasamatho sabbūpadhi-paṭinissaggo tahakkhayo virāgo nirodho nibbānaṃ.
dn14:3.4.9: Ahañ c' eva kho pana dhammaṃ deseyyaṃ, pare ca me na ājāneyyuṃ, so mam' assa kilamatho, sā mam' assa vihesā ti.'
dn14:3.4.10: Api 'ssu maṃ Brahme imā anacchariyā gāthā paṭibhaṃsu pubbe assutapubbā:
dn14:3.4.19: "‘Iti ha me Brahme paṭisañcikkhato appossukkatāya cittaṃ nami no dhamma-desanāyāti." 5.
dn14:3.5.1: ‘Dutiyam pi kho bhikkhave so Mahā-brahmā . . . pe . . . 6.
dn14:3.5.2: ‘Tatiyam pi kho bhikkhave so Mahā-brahmā Vipassiṃ Bhagavantaṃ arahantaṃ sammā-sambuddhaṃ etad avoca:
dn14:3.5.3: "‘Desetu bhante bhagavā dhammaṃ, desetu sugato dhammaṃ, santi sattā appa-rajakkha-jātikā assavanatā dhammassa parihāyanti, bhavissanti dhammassa aññātāro ti.'
dn14:3.6.1: ‘Atha kho bhikkhave Vipassī bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho Brahmuno ca ajjhesanaṃ viditvā sattesu ca kāruññatam paṭicca buddha-cakkhunā lokaṃ volokesi.
dn14:3.6.2: Addasā kho bhikkhave Vipassī bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho buddha-cakkhunā lokaṃ volokento, satte appa-rajakkhe mahā-rajakkhe tikkhindriye mudindriye svākāre dvākāre suviññāpaye duviññāpaye app ekacce paraloka-vajja-bhaya-dassāvino viharante.
dn14:3.6.3: Seyyatha pi nāma uppaliniyaṃ vā paduminiyaṃ vā puṇḍarīkiniyaṃ vā app ekaccāni uppalāni vā padumāni vā puṇḍarīkāni vā udake jātāni udake saṃvaḍḍhāni udakānuggatāni anto-nimugga-posīni, app ekaccāni uppalāni vā padumāni vā puṇḍarīkāni vā udake jātāni udake saṃvaḍḍhāni samodakaṃ ṭhitāni, app ekaccāni uppalāni vā padumāni vā puṇḍarīkāni vā udake jātāni udake saṃvaḍḍhāni udakā accuggamma ṭhanti anupalittāni udakena, --
dn14:3.6.4: evam eva kho bhikkhave Vipassī bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho buddha-cakkhunā lokaṃ volokento addasa satte appa-rajakkhe mahā-rajakkhe tikkhindriye mudindriye svākāre dvākāre suviññāpaye duviññāpaye app ekacce paraloka-vajja-bhaya-dassāvino viharante. 7.
dn14:3.7.1: ‘Atha kho so bhikkhave Mahā-brahmā Vipassissa bhagavato arahato sammā -sambuddhassa cetasā cetoparivitakkam aññāya Vipassiṃ bhagavantaṃ arahantaṃ sammā-sambuddhaṃ gāthāhi ajjhabhāsi:
dn14:3.7.12: ‘Atha kho bhikkhave Vipassī bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho taṃ Mahā-brahmānaṃ gāthāya paccabhāsi.
dn14:3.7.17: ‘Atha kho so bhikkhave Mahā-brahmā "Katāvakāso kho 'mhi Vipassinā bhagavatā arahatā sammā-sambuddhena dhamma-desanāyāti" Vipassiṃ bhagavantaṃ arahantaṃ sammā-sambuddhaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā tatth' ev' antaradhāyi. 8.
dn14:3.8.1: ‘Atha kho bhikkhave Vipassissa bhagavato arahato sammā-sambuddhassa etad ahosi:
dn14:3.8.2: "Kassa nu kho ahaṃ paṭhamaṃ dhammaṃ deseyyaṃ,
dn14:3.8.3: ko imaṃ dhammaṃ khippam eva ājānissatīti?"
dn14:3.8.4: ‘Atha kho bhikkhave Vipassissa bhagavato arahato sammā-sambuddhassa etad ahosi:
dn14:3.8.5: "Ayaṃ kho Khaṇḍo ca rāja-putto Tisso ca purohita-putto Bandhumatiyā rāja-dhāniyā paṭivasanti paṇḍitā vyattā medhāvino dīgha-rattaṃ apparajakkha-jātikā.
dn14:3.8.6: Yannūnāhaṃ Khaṇḍassa ca rāja-puttassa Tissassa ca purohita-puttassa paṭhamaṃ dhammaṃ deseyyaṃ, te imaṃ dhammaṃ khippam eva ajānissantīti."
dn14:3.9.1: ‘Atha kho bhikkhave Vipassī bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho, seyyathā pi nāma balavā puriso sammiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya, pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ sammiñjeyya, evam eva kho bodhi-rukkha-mūle antarahito Bandhumatiyā rāja-dhāniyā Kheme miga-dāye pātur ahosi . 9.
dn14:3.9.2: ‘Atha kho bhikkhave Vipassī bhagavā arahaṃ sammā-sambuddho dāya-pālaṃ āmantesi:
dn14:3.9.3: "‘Ehi tvaṃ samma dāya-pāla, Bandhumatiṃ rājadhāniṃ pavisitvā Khaṇḍañ ca rāja-puttaṃ Tissaṃ ca purohita-puttaṃ evaṃ vadehi:
dn14:3.9.4: ‘Vipassī bhante bhagavā arahaṃ sammā-sambuddho Bandhumatiṃ rāja-dhāniṃ anuppatto Kheme miga-dāye viharati. So tumhākaṃ dassana-kāmo ti.' "
dn14:3.9.5: "‘Evaṃ bhante" ti kho bhikkhave dāya-pālo Vipassissa bhagavato arahato sammā-sambuddhassa paṭissutvā Bandhumatiṃ rāja-dhāniṃ pavisitvā Khaṇḍañ ca rājaputtaṃ. Tissañ ca purohita-puttaṃ etad avoca:
dn14:3.9.6: "‘Vipassī bhante bhagavā arahaṃ sammā-sambuddho Bandhumatiṃ rāja-dhāniṃ anuppatto Kheme miga-dāye viharati. So tumhākaṃ dassana-kāmo ti." 10.
dn14:3.10.1: ‘Atha kho bhikkhave Khaṇḍo ca rāja-putto Tisso ca purohita-putto bhaddāni bhaddāni yānāni yojāpetvā bhaddaṃ yānaṃ abhiruhitvā bhaddehi bhaddehi yānehi Bandhumatiyā rāja-dhāniyā nīyiṃsu, yena Khemo migadāyo tena pāyaṃsu,
dn14:3.10.2: yāvatikā yānassa bhūmi yānena gantvā yānā paccorohitvā pattikā va yena Vipassī bhagavā arahaṃ sammā-sambuddho ten' upasaṃkamiṃsu. Upasaṃkamitvā Vipassiṃ bhagavantaṃ arahantaṃ sammā-sambuddhaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. 11.
dn14:3.11.1: ‘Tesaṃ Vipassī bhagavā arahaṃ sammā-sambuddho ānupubbi-kathaṃ kathesi, seyyathīdaṃ
dn14:3.11.2: dāna-kathaṃ sīla-kathaṃ sagga-kathaṃ kāmānaṃ ādīnavaṃ okāraṃ saṃkilesaṃ nekkhamme ānisaṃsaṃ pakāsesi.
dn14:3.11.3: Yadā te bhagavā aññāsi kalla-citte mudu-citte vinīvaraṇa-citte udagga-citte pasanna-citte, atha yā Buddhānaṃ sāmukkaṃsikā dhamma-desanā tam pakāsesi,
dn14:3.11.5: Seyyathā pi nāma suddhaṃ vatthaṃ apagata-kāḷakaṃ sammad eva rajanaṃ paṭigaṇheyya,
dn14:3.11.6: evam eva Khaṇḍassa ca rāja-puttassa Tissassa ca purohitaputtassa tasmiṃ yeva āsane virajaṃ vītamalaṃ dhammacakkhuṃ udapādi:
dn14:3.11.7: "Yaṃ kiñci samudaya -- dhammaṃ, sabban taṃ nirodha-dhamman ti." 12.
dn14:3.12.1: ‘Te diṭṭha-dhammā patta-dhammā vidita-dhammā pariyogāḷha-dhammā tiṇṇa-vicikicchā vigata-kathaṃkathā vesārajja-ppattā apara-ppaccayā satthu sāsane Vipassiṃ bhagavantaṃ arahantaṃ sammā-sambuddhaṃ etad avocuṃ:
dn14:3.12.3: Seyyathā pi bhante nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya, paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya, mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya, andhakāre vā tela-pajjotaṃ dhāreyya ‘cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhintīti,' evam eva Bhagavatā anekka-pariyāyena dhammo pakāsito.
dn14:3.12.4: Ete mayaṃ bhante Bhagavantaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāma, dhammañ ca.
dn14:3.12.5: Labheyyāma mayaṃ bhante Bhagavato santike pabbajjaṃ, labheyyāma upasampadan ti." 13.
dn14:3.13.1: ‘Alatthuṃ kho bhikkhave Khaṇḍo ca rāja-putto Tisso ca purohita-putto Vipassissa bhagavato arahato sammā-sambuddhassa santike pabbajjaṃ, alatthuṃ upasampadaṃ.
dn14:3.13.2: Te Vipassī bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho dhammiyā kathāya sandassesi samādapesi samuttejesi sampahaṅsesi,
dn14:3.13.3: saṃkhārānaṃ ādīnavaṃ okāraṃ saṃkilesaṃ nibbāne ānisaṃsaṃ pakāsesi.
dn14:3.13.4: Tesaṃ Vipassinā bhagavatā arahatā sammā-sambuddhena dhammiyā kathāya sandassiyamānānaṃ samādapiyamānānaṃ samuttejiyamānānaṃ sampahaṅsiyamānānaṃ na cirass' eva anupādāya āsavehi cittāni vimucciṃsu. 14.
dn14:3.14.1: ‘Assosi kho bhikkhave Bandhumatiyā rāja-dhāniyā mahā-jana-kāyo caturāsīti-pāṇa-sahassāni:
dn14:3.14.2: "Vipassī kira bhagavā arahaṃ sammā-sambuddho Bandhumatiṃ rājadhāniṃ anuppatto Kheme miga-dāye viharati.
dn14:3.14.3: Khaṇḍo ca kira rāja-putto Tisso ca purohita-putto Vipassissa bhagavato arahato sammā-sambuddhassa santike kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitā ti."
dn14:3.14.5: "Na hi nūna so orako dhamma-vinayo, na sā orikā pabbajjā, yattha Khaṇḍo ca rāja-putto Tisso ca purohitaputto kesa-massuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitā.
dn14:3.14.6: Khaṇḍo ca hi nāma rājaputto, Tisso ca purohita-putto Vipassissa bhagavato arahato sammā-sambuddhassa santike kesa-massuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajissanti, kim aṅga pana na mayan ti?"
dn14:3.14.7: ‘Atha kho so bhikkhave mahā-jana-kāyo caturāsīti pāṇa-sahassāni Bandhumatiyā rāja-dhāniyā nikkhamitvā yena Khemo miga-dāyo yena Vipassī bhagavā arahaṃ sammā-sambuddho ten' upakamiṃsu, upasaṃkamitvā Vipassiṃ bhagavantaṃ arahantaṃ sammā-sambuddhaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. 15.
dn14:3.15.1: ‘Tesaṃ Vipassī bhagavā arahaṃ sammā-sambuddho ānupubbi-kathaṃ kathesi,
dn14:3.15.2: seyyathīdaṃ dāna-kathaṃ sīlakathaṃ sagga-kathaṃ kāmānaṃ ādīnavaṃ okāraṃ saṃkilesaṃ nekkhamme ānisaṅsaṃ pakāsesi.
dn14:3.15.3: Yadā te bhagavā aññāsi kalla-citte mudu-citte vinīvaraṇa-citte udagga-citte pasanna-citte, atha yā Buddhānaṃ sāmuk kaṃsikā dhamma-desanā taṃ pakāsesi
dn14:3.15.5: Seyyathā pi nāma suddhaṃ vatthaṃ apagata-kāḷakaṃ sammad eva rajanaṃ paṭigaṇheyya,
dn14:3.15.6: evam eva tesaṃ caturāsīti-pāṇasahassānaṃ tasmiṃ yeva āsane virajaṃ vītamalaṃ dhamma-cakkhuṃ udapādi:
dn14:3.15.7: "Yaṃ kiñci samudayadhammaṃ sabban taṃ nirodha-dhamman ti." 16.

dn14:3.16.3: Seyyathā pi bhante nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya , paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya, mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya, andhakāre vā tela-pajjotaṃ dhāreyya ‘cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhintīti,' evam eva Bhagavatā aneka-pariyāyena dhammo pakāsito.
dn14:3.16.4: Ete mayaṃ bhante Bhagavantaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāma dhammañ ca.
dn14:3.16.5: Labheyyāma mayaṃ bhante Bhagavato santike pabbajjaṃ, labheyyāma upasampadan ti." 17.

dn14:3.17.2: Te Vipassī bhagavā arahaṃ sammā-sambuddho dhammiyā kathāya sandassesi samādapesi samuttejesi saṃpahaṃsesi,

dn14:3.18.2: "Vipassī kira bhagavā arahaṃ sammā-sambuddho Bandhumatiṃ rāja-dhāniṃ anuppatto Kheme miga-dāye viharati, dhammañ ca kira desetīti."

dn14:3.20.3: Seyyathā pi bhante nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya , paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya, mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya, andhakāre vā tela-pajjotaṃ dhāreyya "cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhintīti," evam eva Bhagavatā aneka-pariyāyena dhammo pakāsito.

dn14:3.20.5: Labheyyāma mayaṃ bhante Bhagavato santike pabbajjaṃ, labheyyāma upasampadan ti." 21.
dn14:3.21.1: ‘Alatthuṃ kho bhikkhave tāni caturāsītiṃ pabbajita-sahassāni Vipassissa bhagavato arahato sammā-sambuddhassa santike pabbajjaṃ, alatthuṃ upasampadaṃ.
dn14:3.21.2: Te Vipassī bhagavā arahaṃ sammā-sambuddho dhammiyā kathāya sandassesi samādapesi samuttejesi sampahaṅsesi,
dn14:3.21.3: saṃkhārānaṃ ādīnavaṃ okāraṃ saṃkilesaṃ nibbāne ānisaṃsaṃ pakāsesi.
dn14:3.21.4: Tesaṃ Vipassinā bhagavatā arahatā sammā-sambuddhena dhammiyā kathāya sandassiyamānānaṃ samādapiyamānānaṃ samuttejiyamānānaṃ sampahaṅsiyamānānaṃ na cirass' eva anupādāya āsavehi cittāni vimucciṃsu . 22.
dn14:3.22.1: ‘Tena kho pana bhikkhave samayena Bandhumatiyā rāja-dhāniyā mahā-bhikkhu-saṃgho paṭivasati aṭṭhasaṭṭhiṃ bhikkhu-sata-sahassaṃ.
dn14:3.22.2: Atha kho bhikkhave Vipassissa bhagavato arahato sammā-sambuddhassa rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi:
dn14:3.22.3: "‘Mahā kho etarahi bhikkhu-saṃgho Bandhumatiyā rāja-dhāniyā paṭivasati aṭṭha-saṭṭhiṃ bhikkhu-sata-sahassam. Yannūnāhaṃ bhikkhū anujāneyyaṃ:
dn14:3.22.4: ‘Caratha bhikkhave cārikaṃ bahujana-hitāya bahujana-sukhāya lokānukampāya atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānaṃ.
dn14:3.22.6: desetha bhikkhave dhammaṃ ādi-kalyāṇaṃ majjhe kalyāṇaṃ pariyosāna-kalyāṇaṃ sāttham savyañjanaṃ kevala-paripuṇṇaṃ parisuddham brahmacariyaṃ pakāsetha.
dn14:3.22.7: Santi sattā appa-rajakkha-jātikā assavanatā dhammassa parihāyanti,
dn14:3.22.9: Api ca channaṃ channaṃ vassānaṃ accayena Bandhumatī rāja-dhānī upasaṃkamitabbā pātimokkhuddesāyāti.' " 23.
dn14:3.23.1: ‘Atha kho bhikkhave aññataro Mahā-brahmā Vipassissa bhagavato arahato sammā-sambuddhassa cetasā ceto-parivitakkam aññāya, seyyathā pi nāma balavā puriso sammiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya, pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ sammiñjeyya, evam eva Brahma-loke antarahito Vipassissa bhagavato arahato sammā-sambuddhassa purato pātur ahosi.
dn14:3.23.2: Atha kho bhikkhave Mahābrahmā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā yena Vipassī bhagavā arahaṃ sammā-sambuddho ten' añjalim paṇāmetvā Vipassiṃ bhagavantaṃ arahantaṃ sammā-sambuddhaṃ etad avoca:
dn14:3.23.4: Mahā kho bhante etarahi bhikkhu-saṃgho Bandhumatiyā rājadhāniyā paṭivasati aṭṭha-saṭṭhiṃ bhikkhu-saka-sahassaṃ, anujānātu bhante Bhagavā bhikkhū:
dn14:3.23.5: ‘Caratha bhikkhave cārikaṃ bahujana-hitāya bahujana-sukhāya lokānukampāya atthāya hitāya sukhāya deva-manussānaṃ.
dn14:3.23.7: desetha bhikkhave dhammaṃ ādikalyāṇaṃ majjhe kalyāṇaṃ pariyosāna-kalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ savyañjanaṃ kevala-paripuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ pakāsetha.
dn14:3.23.8: Santi sattā appa-rajakkha-jātikā, assavanatā dhammassa parihāyanti, bhavissanti dhammassa aññātāro .
dn14:3.23.9: Api ca bhante mayaṃ tathā karissāma yathā bhikkhū channaṃ channaṃ vassānaṃ accayena Bandhumatiṃ rāja-dhāniṃ upasaṃkamissanti pātimokkhuddesāyāti."
dn14:3.23.11: Idaṃ vatvā Vipassiṃ bhagavantaṃ arahantaṃ sammā-sambuddhaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā tatth' ev' antaradhāyi. 24.
dn14:3.24.1: ‘Atha kho bhikkhave Vipassī bhagavā arahaṃ sammā-sambuddho sāyaṇha-samaye paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito bhikkhū āmantesi:
dn14:3.24.2: "‘Idha mayhaṃ bhikkhave rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi:
dn14:3.24.3: ‘Mahā kho etarahi bhikkhu-saṃgho Bandhumatiyā rāja-dhāniyā paṭivasati aṭṭha-saṭṭhiṃ bhikkhu-sata-sahassaṃ.
dn14:3.24.5: "Caratha bhikkhave cārikaṃ bahujana-hitāya bahujana-sukhāya lokānukampāya atthāya hitāya sukhāya deva-manussānaṃ.
dn14:3.24.7: desetha bhikkhave dhammaṃ ādi-kalyāṇaṃ majjhe kalyāṇaṃ pariyosāna-kalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ savyañjanaṃ kevala-paripuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ pakāsetha.
dn14:3.24.8: Santi sattā appa-rajakkha-jātikā, assavanatā dhammassa parihāyanti, bhavissanti dhammassa aññātāro.
dn14:3.24.9: Api ca channaṃ channaṃ vassānaṃ accayena Bandhumatī rāja-dhānī upasaṃkamitabbā pātimokkhuddesāyāti."' 25.
dn14:3.25.1: "‘Atha kho bhikkhave aññataro Mahā-brahmā mama cetaso ceto-parivitakkam aññāya, seyyathā pi nāma balavā puriso sammiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya, pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ sammiñjeyya, evam eva Brahma-loke antarahito mama purato pātur ahosi.
dn14:3.25.2: Atha kho so bhikkhave Mahā-brahmā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā yenāhaṃ ten' añjalim paṇāmetvā maṃ etad avoca:
dn14:3.25.4: Mahā kho bhante etarahi bhikkhu-saṃgho Bandhumatiyā rāja -dhāniyā paṭivasati aṭṭha- saṭṭhiṃ bhikkhu-sata-sahassaṃ,
dn14:3.25.6: "Caratha bhikkhave cārikaṃ bahujana-hitāya bahujana-sukhāya lokānukampāya atthāya hitāya sukhāya deva-manussānaṃ.
dn14:3.25.8: desetha bhikkhave dhammaṃ ādi-kalyāṇaṃ majjhe kalyāṇaṃ pariyosāna-kalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ savyañjanaṃ kevala-paripuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ pakāsetha.
dn14:3.25.9: Santi sattā appa-rajakkha-jātika, assavanatā dhammassa parihāyanti, bhavissanti dhammassa aññātāro.
dn14:3.25.10: Api ca bhante mayaṃ tathā karissāma, yathā bhikkhū channaṃ channaṃ vassānaṃ accayena Bandhumatiṃ rāja-dhāniṃ upasaṃkamissanti pātimokkhuddesāyāti.'
dn14:3.25.12: Idaṃ vatvā maṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā tatth' ev' antaradhāyi. 26.
dn14:3.26.1: "‘Anujānāmi bhikkhave! Caratha cārikaṃ bahujana-hitāya bahujana-sukhāya lokānukampāya atthāya hitāya sukhāya deva-manussānaṃ.
dn14:3.26.3: desetha bhikkhave dhammaṃ ādi-kalyāṇaṃ majjhe kalyāṇaṃ pariyosāna-kalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ savyañjanaṃ kevala-paripuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ pakāsetha.
dn14:3.26.4: Santi sattā apparajakkha-jātikā, assavanatā dhammassa parihāyanti,
dn14:3.26.6: Api ca bhikkhave channaṃ channaṃ vassānaṃ accayena Bandhumatī rāja-dhānī upasaṃkamitabbā pātimokkhuddesāyāti."
dn14:3.26.7: ‘Atha kho te bhikkhave bhikkhū yebhuyyena ekāhen' eva janapada-cārikaṃ pakkamiṃsu. 27.
dn14:3.27.1: ‘Tena kho pana bhikkhave samayena Jambudīpe caturāsītiṃ āvāsa-sahassāni honti.
dn14:3.27.2: Ekamhi vasse nikkhante devatā saddam anussāvesuṃ:
dn14:3.27.5: Pañcannaṃ vassānaṃ accayena Bandhumatī rāja-dhānī upasaṃkamitabbā pātimokkhuddesāyāti."
dn14:3.27.6: Dvīsu vassesu nikkhantesu devatā saddam anussāvesuṃ: "Nikkhantāni kho mārisā dve vassāni, cattāri dāni vassāni sesāni. Catunnaṃ vassānaṃ accayena Bandhumatī rāja-dhānī upasaṃkamitabbā pātimokkhuddesāyāti.
dn14:3.27.7: Tīsu vassesu nikkhantesu devatā saddam anussāvesuṃ: "Nikkhantani kho mārisā tīṇi vassāni, tīṇi dāni vassāni sesāni. Tiṇṇaṃ vassānaṃ accayena Bandhumatī rājadhānī upasaṃkamitabbā pātimokkhuddesāyāti."
dn14:3.27.8: ‘Catusu vassesu nikkhantesu devatā saddam anussāvesuṃ: "Nikkhantāni kho mārisā cattāri vassāni, dve dāni vassāni sesāni. Dvinnaṃ vassānaṃ accayena Bandhumatī rāja-dhānī upasaṃkamitabbā pātimokkhuddesāyāti."
dn14:3.27.12: Ekassa vassassa accayena Bandhumati rāja-dhānī upasaṃkamitabbā pātimokkhuddesāyāti."
dn14:3.27.15: samayo dāni Bandhumatiṃ rāja-dhāniṃ upasaṃkamituṃ pātimokkhuddesāyāti."
dn14:3.27.16: ‘Atha kho te bhikkhave bhikkhū, app ekacce saken' eva iddhānubhāvena app ekacce devānaṃ iddhānubhāvena, ekāhen' eva Bandhumatiṃ rāja-dhāniṃ upasaṃkamiṃsu pātimokkhuddesāyāti. 28.
dn14:3.28.1: ‘Tatra sudaṃ bhikkhave Vipassī bhagavā arahaṃ sammā-sambuddho bhikkhu-saṃghe evaṃ pātimokkhaṃ uddisati:
dn14:3.29.1: ‘Ekam idāhaṃ bhikkhave samayaṃ Ukkaṭṭhāyaṃ viharāmi Subhaga-vane sāla-rāja-mūle.
dn14:3.29.2: Tassa mayhaṃ bhikkhave rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi:
dn14:3.29.3: "Na kho so sattāvāso sulabha-rūpo yo mayā anāvuttha-pubbo iminā dīghena addhunā aññatra suddhāvāsehi devehi.
dn14:3.29.4: Yan nūnāhaṃ yena Suddhāvāsā devā ten' upasaṃkameyyan ti."
dn14:3.29.5: ‘Atha kho ahaṃ bhikkhave seyyathā pi nāma balavā puriso sammiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya, pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ sammiñjeyya, evam eva Ukkaṭṭhāyaṃ Subhagavane sāla-rāja-mūle antarahito Avihesu devesu pātur ahosiṃ .
dn14:3.29.6: Tasmiṃ bhikkhave deva-nikāye 'nekāni devatā-sahassāni yenāhaṃ ten' upasaṃkamiṃsu, upasaṃkamitvā maṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu. Ekamantaṃ ṭhitā kho bhikkhave tā devatā maṃ etad avocuṃ:
dn14:3.29.7: "‘Ito so mārisa eka-navute kappe yaṃ Vipassī bhagavā arahaṃ sammā-sambuddho loke udapādi.
dn14:3.29.8: Vipassī mārisa bhagavā arahaṃ sammā-sambuddho Khattiyo jātiyā ahosi, Khattiya-kule udapādi.
dn14:3.29.9: Vipassī mārisa bhagavā arahaṃ sammā- sambuddho Koṇḍañño gottena ahosi.
dn14:3.29.10: Vipassissa mārisa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa asīti-vassa-sahassāni āyuppamāṇaṃ ahosi.
dn14:3.29.11: Vipassī mārisa bhagavā arahaṃ sammā-sambuddho pāṭaliyā mūle abhisambuddho.
dn14:3.29.12: Vipassissa bhagavato arahato sammā-sambuddhassa Khaṇḍa-Tissaṃ nāma sāvakayugaṃ ahosi aggaṃ bhadda-yugaṃ.
dn14:3.29.13: Vipassissa mārisa bhagavato arahato sammā-sambuddhassa tayo sāvakānaṃ sannipātā ahesuṃ, eko sāvakānaṃ sannipāto ahosi aṭṭhasaṭṭhi-bhikkhu-sata-sahassaṃ, eko sāvakānaṃ sannipāto ahosi bhikkhu-sata-sahassaṃ, eko sāvakānaṃ sannipāto ahosi asīti-bhikkhu-sata-sahassāni. Vipassissa mārisa bhagavato arahato sammā-sambuddhassa ime tayo sāvakānaṃ sannipātā ahesuṃ sabbesaṃ yeva khīṇāsavānaṃ.
dn14:3.29.14: Vipassissa mārisa bhagavato arahato sammā-sambuddhassa Asoko nāma bhikkhu upaṭṭhāko ahosi aggupaṭṭhāko.
dn14:3.29.15: Vipassissa mārisa bhagavato arahato sammā-sambuddhassa Bandhumā nāma rājā pitā ahosi,
dn14:3.29.16: Bandhumatī nāma devī mātā ahosi janettī,
dn14:3.29.17: Bandhumassa rañño Bandhumatī nāma rāja-nagaraṃ rājadhānī ahosi.
dn14:3.29.18: Vipassissa mārisa bhagavato arahato sammā-sambuddhassa evaṃ abhinikkhamanaṃ ahosi, evaṃ pabbajjā, evaṃ padhānaṃ, evaṃ abhisambodhi, evaṃ dhammacakka-pavattanaṃ.
dn14:3.29.19: Te mayaṃ mārisa Vipassimhi bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ caritvā kāmesu kāmacchandaṃ virājetvā idh' uppannā ti." 30. ‘Tasmiṃ yeva kho bhikkhave deva-nikāye 'nekāni devatā-sahassāni . . .
dn14:3.30.1: nekāni devatā-satāni yenāhaṃ ten' upasaṃkamiṃsu, upasaṃkamitvā maṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu. Ekamantaṃ ṭhitā kho bhikkhave tā devatā maṃ etad avocuṃ:
dn14:3.30.2: "‘Imasmiṃ yeva kho mārisa bhadda-kappe bhagavā etarahi arahaṃ sammā-sambuddho loke uppanno.
dn14:3.30.3: Bhagavā mārisa Khattiyo jātiyā Khattiya-kule uppanno.
dn14:3.30.5: Bhagavato mārisa appakaṃ āyuppamāṇaṃ parittaṃ lahusaṃ, yo ciraṃ jīvati so vassa-sataṃ appaṃ vā bhiyyo.
dn14:3.30.7: Bhagavato mārisa Sāriputta-Moggallānā sāvaka-yugaṃ aggaṃ bhaddayugaṃ.
dn14:3.30.8: Bhagavato mārisa eko sāvakānaṃ sannipāto ahosi aḍḍhateḷasāni bhikkhu-satāni. Bhagavato mārisa ayaṃ eko sāvakānaṃ sannipāto ahosi sabbesaṃ yeva khīṇāsavānaṃ.
dn14:3.30.9: Bhagavato mārisa Ānando bhikkhu upaṭṭhāko ahosi aggupaṭṭhāko.
dn14:3.30.13: Bhagavato mārisa evaṃ abhinikkhamanaṃ ahosi, evaṃ pabbajjā, evaṃ padhānaṃ, evaṃ abhisambodhi, evaṃ dhammacakka-pavattanaṃ.
dn14:3.30.14: Te mayaṃ mārisa Bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ caritvā kāmesu kāmacchandaṃ virājetvā idh' uppannā ti." 31.
dn14:3.31.1: ‘Atha kho 'haṃ bhikkhave Avihehi devehi saddhiṃ yena Atappā devā ten' upasaṃkamiṃ .
dn14:3.31.2: Atha khvāhaṃ bhikkhave Avihehi ca devehi Atappehi ca devehi saddhiṃ yena Sudassā devā ten' upasaṃkamiṃ.
dn14:3.31.3: Atha khvāhaṃ bhikkhave Avihehi ca devehi Atappehi ca devehi Sudassehi ca devehi saddhiṃ yena Sudassī devā ten' upasaṃkamiṃ. Atha khvāhaṃ bhikkhave Avihehi ca devehi Atappehi ca devehi Sudassehi ca devehi Sudassīhi ca devehi saddhiṃ yena Akaniṭṭhā devā ten' upasaṃkamiṃ. Tasmiṃ bhikkhave deva-nikāye nekāni devatāsahassāni yenāhaṃ ten' upasaṃkamiṃsu, upasaṃkamitvā maṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu. Ekamantaṃ ṭhitā kho bhikkhave tā devatā maṃ etad avocuṃ:
dn14:3.31.4: "‘Ito so mārisa eka-navute kappe yaṃ Vipassī bhagavā arahaṃ sammā- sambuddho loke udapādi . . .
dn14:3.31.21: ‘Tasmiṃ yeva kho bhikkhave deva-nikāye nekāni devatā-sahassāni . . . pe . . . nekāni devatā satāni yenāhaṃ ten' upasaṃkamiṃsu, upasaṃkamitvā maṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu. Ekamantaṃ ṭhitā kho bhikkhave tā devatā maṃ etad avocuṃ :
dn14:3.32.2: bhagavā etarahi arahaṃ sammā-sambuddho loke uppanno.
dn14:3.33.1: ‘Iti kho bhikkhave Tathāgatass' ev' esā dhammadhātu suppaṭividdhā yassā dhamma- dhātuyā suppaṭividdhattā Tathāgato atīte Buddhe parinibbute chinna-papañce chinna-vaṭume pariyādinna -vaṭṭe sabba-dukkha-vītivatte jātito pi anussarati, nāmato pi anussarati, gottato pi anussarati, āyuppamāṇato pi anussarati, sāvaka-yugato pi anussarati, sāvaka-sannipātato pi anussarati: " Evaṃjaccā te Bhagavanto ahesuṃ iti pi,
dn14:3.33.2: evaṃ-nāmā evaṃgottā evaṃ-sīlā evaṃ-dhammā evaṃ-paññā evaṃ-vihārī evaṃ-vimuttā te Bhagavanto ahesuṃ
dn14:3.33.6: Attamanā te bhikkhū Bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandun ti. MAHĀPADĀNA-SUTTANTAṂ SAMATTAṂ. 1.
